purpose: Four-arm powered band study: same-substrate solos and C0+/C1+ portfolios

operational_preflight.note: Extra portfolio-arm cells, excluded from the 96-cell main matrix; observation only, not a gate.

dispatch_order.block_order: for each analysis seed in listed order, p03, p07, p08, p09
dispatch_order.rule: Each block's four arms dispatch adjacently; order is fixed and never adapted to results.

band_rule: A problem is in the band iff, across all portfolio cells in Waves A and C under the graders' protocol, it has at least one Comparator pass and at least one fail; applied before launch.
selection_note: The mechanical band rule selects p03, p07, p08, and p09. The 600-second regrade left rmo_2000_6 with no passes.
stopping_rule: Intention-to-treat on all cells completed at time of analysis; time recorded.
solo_control_note: Each solo cell retains 25 calls on its one model. A same-model two-track portfolio is computed analytically from independent single-track rates; solo calls are not raised to 50.
